items.question: What age range does kindergarten cover in UAE government schools under the Ministry of Education?
items.gold: Kindergarten in government schools covers children aged 4-5 years.
items.fact: Kindergarten in government schools covers ages 4-5.

items.question: How many grades does each school stage have in UAE government schools since the 2018-2019 academic year?
items.gold: Each school stage has four grades instead of six.
items.fact: From 2018-2019, each government school stage has four grades.
